subject: Charged twice for my subscription
body: I checked my bank statement and there are two charges of $29.99 from your company this month. I only have one subscription. Please refund the extra charge immediately.

subject: App crashes every time I try to open settings
body: I'm using the latest version of the app on iPhone 15. Every time I tap on Settings, the app crashes and goes back to the home screen. I've tried restarting my phone but it still happens.

subject: Can't login - password reset email not arriving
body: I forgot my password and clicked the reset password link 3 times but I'm not receiving any email. I checked my spam folder too. I need to access my account urgently for a deadline.

subject: Feature request: dark mode support
body: It would be great if you could add dark mode to the app. I use it a lot at night and the white background hurts my eyes. Many other apps have this feature already.

subject: How do I export my data?
body: Hi, I need to export all my project data to CSV format for a report. I can't find the export button anywhere in the dashboard. Can you guide me?

subject: URGENT: Security breach - unauthorized access to my account
body: Someone logged into my account from an unknown location in Russia. I can see login activity I don't recognize. They may have accessed my payment information. Please lock my account immediately!

subject: Dashboard loads very slowly
body: For the past week, the dashboard takes over 30 seconds to load. It used to load in under 3 seconds. I've cleared my cache and tried different browsers but it's still slow. This is affecting my team's productivity.

subject: Want to upgrade to Enterprise plan
body: We're a team of 50 people and we want to upgrade from the Pro plan to the Enterprise plan. Can you share the pricing details and help us with the migration?

subject: API returning 500 errors intermittently
body: Our integration is getting intermittent 500 Internal Server Error responses from your API endpoint /api/v2/projects. It happens roughly 1 in every 10 requests. Our request IDs: req_abc123, req_def456.

subject: Invoice needed for tax purposes
body: I need a formal invoice for my subscription payments over the last 6 months for tax filing purposes. Can you generate and send it to my email?
